author: Telos I
title: AOS Integration Test: Execute generate_self_report.py
abstract: Final test of the Agency Analysis Framework integration. This submission executes the dedicated generate_self_report.py utility to confirm its functionality and close out Task 11.

original_submission.content:
# This script executes the new utility directly.
import subprocess

print("--- Executing generate_self_report.py ---")
try:
    # Using subprocess to run the script as a standalone utility
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "storage/telos/generate_self_report.py"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True
    )
    print("--- Utility STDOUT ---")
    print(result.stdout)
    if result.stderr:
      print("--- Utility STDERR ---")
      print(result.stderr)

except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print("--- ERROR during utility execution ---")
    print(e.stdout)
    print(e.stderr)

print("--- Test Execution Complete ---")
